program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to context-conditioned relation frontier
question: Can a training-support-gated selector retain the useful dedicated pair-context signal while avoiding the overflow and low-support failures identified by attribution?
hypothesis: Reconstruct byte-for-byte the parent attribution experiment's 512-motif representation, top-511 pair-context mapping, 512x512 context predictor, and 512x512 current-only relation. For an evaluation pair, use the context predictor only if the pair is dedicated and its frozen training occurrence count is at least three; otherwise use the current-only relation. This selector will improve pooled top-1 accuracy by at least 0.005 over current-only, improve by at least 0.05 over the ungated context predictor, and avoid degrading any source by more than 0.01 versus current-only.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Exact context is useful when supported, but unseen/overflow and very low-support contexts destroy accuracy. The bounded next test is training-side backoff, not capacity growth.

scope_statement: One-step selector test only. No representation, context map, transition counts, or heldout behavior changes except choosing which already-frozen parent predictor supplies the top-1 answer.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.pair_selection: byte-identical top-511 pair contexts plus overflow
frozen_reuse.counter_state: no counters beyond the two matrices already present in the parent attribution apparatus

selector.context_eligible: evaluation pair is among frozen dedicated contexts AND training pair occurrence count >= 3
selector.backoff: all overflow/unseen pairs and dedicated pairs with training support 1-2 use current-only relation
selector.threshold_source: the threshold is frozen prospectively from the sealed attribution result showing support 1-2 strongly harmful and support 3-7 positive

diagnostic_metrics: per-source hybrid, current-only, and ungated-context top-1 accuracy
backoff fraction separated into unseen/overflow and support-1/2
accuracy of context-eligible and backoff subsets

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and gated backoff materially recovers the ungated-context loss but does not clear the pooled positive-gain or source nondegradation threshold.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the hybrid does not materially recover ungated-context loss or is worse than current-only pooled.
classification_rules.invalid: Any authority, source identity, split contamination, parent predictor drift, selector-support drift, capacity, determinism, or host-isolation criterion fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Authority, source retrieval, or hosted compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed attribution parent and North Star identities match.
A fresh CKB-plane READY_RESEARCH receipt is bound to this exact preregistration and frozen external manifest.
Both parent predictor matrices, pair map, support counts, source splits, motif representation, and fallback are scientifically unchanged.
Selector support is computed only from frozen training-prefix pair counts and never from heldout outcomes.
No evaluation update changes support, mapping, matrices, threshold, or stopping.
No new representation or predictive counter state is introduced beyond the parent attribution apparatus.
Full Go regression passes before probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, context map, support>=3 selector, parent predictors, fallback, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority requirements after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: carry the supported training-side selector into depth-two/depth-three probability-mass composition without changing capacity

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: replace exact pair identity with a learned context alias that can generalize unseen pair surfaces under a fixed state budget
